pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCollects health or hunger from mature Calculator-tree leaves into a matching module.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place beside a three-block trunk, facing away from it.$p2. Provide at least the required nearby leaf count.$p3. Insert a module with matching nutrient capacity and allow leaf maturity.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pWrong trunk orientation, insufficient mature leaves, a full module or denied world actions can stop collection.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
